title: PS5 Homebrew Compendium — Item
description: Schema for a single catalog item, stored as one JSON file at library/platforms/<platformId>/items/<name>.json. The file is a BARE item object (no wrapper).

id.description: Stable slug used in routes (#/item/<id>). By convention the filename is this id with hyphens -> underscores.

category.description: Must match a categories[].id in the manifest (cross-checked by tests/validate-library.mjs).

icon.description: Card/detail icon. Either a named sprite word (gamepad, unlock, tool, app, search, external, close, chevron, alert, check, cpu, sparkle, shield) OR an image URL/path (https://, //, /, ./, ../). An unknown word or a failed image falls back to the item's category icon.

description.description: Longer detail text. Rendered as plain escaped text (no raw HTML/markdown).

version.description: Human string (e.g. "0.6.7-alpha.6"); display only, not compared. Empty string allowed.

updated.description: Date this entry was last verified/updated by the maintainer. Drives the "Recently updated" sort.

platform.description: Device variants the item supports. Omitted/empty = assume PS5.

firmware.description: Inclusive MAJOR.MM compatibility window. Missing bounds mean "unknown", not compatible.

requires.description: Item ids this project depends on. Resolved to links if present; a missing id is warned and rendered as a non-link badge.

license.description: SPDX-ish string (e.g. GPL-3.0). Empty string allowed.

warnings.description: Safety/legal/technical warnings, e.g. "Requires your own BIOS".

verified.description: True only after the maintainer re-checked version/links/firmware. Unverified items render an "Unverified" badge (RISK-01).

featured.description: Pin to the hero featured rail.

order.description: Manual order within its category (used by the "Curated" sort).

platformId.description: READ-ONLY, derived: assigned at load time from the containing platform; not persisted in item files.

media.description: LEGACY (v1) — deprecated. Superseded by the top-level `icon` field and the site banner. Kept for backward compatibility with old inline items; not used by the product.

sourceUrl.description: Official/open-source https URL only (DEC-005). The app renders anchors only for https.
